summary: No demonstrated failure in the bounded independent review. All eight checks pass; the package remained unchanged. Delivery conclusions use inventory basis 5362; learner-selection conclusions are conditional on the supplied rules and representative histories.

source_analysis.skill: Identify every non-pivot column of a supplied row echelon form matrix.
reasoning_steps: Scan each nonzero row for its first nonzero entry.
Collect the column indices of those pivots; ignore zero rows.
Take the complement among all displayed columns, and check exactly those column-vector options.
invariants: Matrix already in row echelon form: increasing leading positions, zero rows last.
No elimination or rank computation required.
Prompts, vectors, checkbox keys and explanation must describe the same matrix.
Source shapes range from 3 to 5 rows and 3 to 5 columns; one or two non-pivot columns.
permitted_variations: Change signs and magnitudes of nonzero pivots and entries to their right; preserve REF.
Change eligible pivot-column assignments within a fixed shape/rank, including leading zero columns and final non-pivot columns. Derive complement anew.
Vary one versus two selected columns where supported by shape/rank and source workload.
Matrix letter, option order and values are incidental; they must not identify a fixed correct subset.
Change irrelevant right-of-pivot entries without changing selected columns. Change leading positions while retaining REF to change selected columns.

source_replay.details: All 17 learner source questions match prompts, worked solutions and complete labelled Boolean banks after whitespace normalization. Canonical e-4704 provides lesson context, not a captured learner answer bank.

math.details: Independent integer parsing checks REF, first nonzero positions, complement keys, all column vectors and solution conclusions: 17 source replays, 120 fresh samples, 58 structural cases, five runner records, three controlled records and 22 captured inventory questions. No demonstrated error.

variety.details: All 58 eligible shape/rank/pivot-position structures are reachable; the maximal batch preserves them after 304 proposals. Exact runner batch has five distinct subsets. Shared delivery retains 120/120 fresh and 5/5 batch records.

scope.details: Generated cases retain easy REF scanning and complement classification with one or two selected columns, observed shapes and small integer entries. No elimination or additional operator is introduced; invalid REF and out-of-family inputs reject.

grading.details: Actual database-free learner grade_field accepts 356 independently correct checkbox actions and rejects 356 incorrect actions. Both Boolean states are tested for every source, boundary structure, batch and controlled-pair field. Free-entry notation is inapplicable.

rendering.details: Unmodified UI renders all five batch records and the controlled before/after records without MathJax, JavaScript, glyph or image errors. Screenshots inspected for matrices, vectors, checkbox states and worked solutions.

packaging.details: Exact declared Python and dependency versions match runtime; deterministic seeded replay and relocated CLI output match. Count boundaries and invalid inputs tested. Package hashes unchanged; no assets or external runtime outputs required.

decision_variation.details: Relevant pivot shift changes the rendered explanation and actual graded selection; irrelevant coefficient edit preserves it. Conditional fixed-subset probes by label and shape reveal no repeated perfect predictor. Batch subsets vary. Selection examined using actual captured easy-only IDs and inspected rules, conditional on easy-positive weights with representative history exclusions; no live learner policy/history was supplied.
